notes.title: Emergency Call 2 | Anniversary Update & Discount
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45318411/844a61f9a081968f358e1bdfc85668c22bd65e56.png[/img]

Emergency Call 112 – The Firefighting Simulation 2 turns four years old!
For this reason, a new update with many fixes and improvements is now available.
In addition to the update, you can also profit from a 30% discount on the Swap Body Vehicle DLC and 35% on Emergency Call 2 from March 30th to April 6th.

Visit the store page here: 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2715800/Notruf_112__Die_Feuerwehr_Simulation_2_WLF__Das_Wechselladerfahrzeug/?l=german

Check out the entire changelog: 

[b]1.2.17277 [/b]
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
BUGFIX:
[list]
[*] Command "Fire Protection" was ignored
[*] Path display can be adjusted in the options
[*] AI couldn't find a place to drop the hose basket near the distributor
[*] AI keeps a greater distance from repositioning emergency vehicles
[*] Targeting the rear seats of the HLF has been simplified
[*] Fixed incorrect light calculation on roads
[*] Fixed incorrectly placed warning lights at the main fire station
[*] Fixed non-functional warning lights at the main fire station
[*] The training dummy can no longer be "rescued" from a vehicle accident before the vehicle is opened
[*] The water monitor no longer gets stuck if the fire cannot be reached from the vehicle's position
[*] NPCs were sometimes unable to drop items
[*] The TLF no longer gets stuck at the traffic light after the Volunteer fire brigade garage fire
[*] Command "Clean street" sometimes did not remove all contaminants
[/list]
